description: Long-lived MCP daemon for warm LSP access (cclsp+intelephense/pyright/etc). Without the daemon, every supertool call cold-starts the LSP — pays indexing cost (~30s+ on large repos) per invocation.

mcp_daemon.description: Start an MCP daemon for SERVER_NAME (from .supertool.json mcp block). Blocking; append --detach to background.

mcp_status.description: List running MCP daemons (name, pid, uptime, idle, socket path).

mcp_stop.description: Stop one MCP daemon by SERVER_NAME (graceful SIGTERM, falls back to SIGKILL after 3s).

mcp_stop_all.description: Stop every supertool MCP daemon found in /tmp/supertool-mcp-*.pid.
